info.title: Industrial Safety Monitoring API
info.description:
REST API over the safety-event database (PostgreSQL). Business rules live in `app/business_rules`; routes only validate
input and call services.

* **Errors** always use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. `404` unknown record, `409` duplicate or illegal state
  change, `422` validation or business-rule violation, `500` unexpected.
* **Lists** are paginated (`page`, `page_size`<=500) and filterable; responses are `{items, total, page, page_size, pages}`.
* **History is append-only**: state, alarm, acknowledgement and status-history rows can be created but never changed or deleted.
* **Timestamps** are ISO-8601 UTC. Naive query timestamps are read as UTC.
* **Business KPIs** (`/analytics`) and **detector evaluation** (`/anomalies/evaluation`) are separate: only the latter reads ground truth.

post.description: Severity is classified (AL-1) from the definition, the machine state in effect and the zone risk; the acknowledgement deadline comes from the severity policy (AL-2). SAFETY_STATE alarms need an UNSAFE state; an identical alarm in the same second is rejected as a duplicate (409).

post.description: Delay and ON_TIME/LATE status are derived from the timestamps (AL-4). An acknowledgement earlier than its alarm is rejected (422 ACK_BEFORE_ALARM); a second acknowledgement is a conflict (409).

post.summary: Create an incident from an unsafe machine state (rule IN-1)
post.description: Requires an UNSAFE machine-state event whose unsafe episode lasted at least 10 s and has a HIGH/CRITICAL alarm on the machine (from 60 s before the episode to its end). Severity follows IN-2. One incident per unsafe episode (409 otherwise).

get.description: Trigger machine state (with interlock events), linked alarms, operator on duty, lifecycle history and corrective actions with their histories. `context_complete=false` marks an incident without trigger context.

schema.title: Response Incident History Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Status History Get

post.summary: Move an incident along its lifecycle (IN-3 / IN-4)
post.description: OPEN > INVESTIGATING > ACTION_IN_PROGRESS > RESOLVED > CLOSED. ACTION_IN_PROGRESS needs a corrective action; RESOLVED needs every live action verified PASSED; CLOSED needs every live action CLOSED. Illegal moves are 409, unmet preconditions 422. The change is appended to the history.

get.summary: Corrective actions of an incident, with histories

schema.title: Response Incident Actions Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Corrective Actions Get

post.summary: Plan a corrective action for an incident (CA-1)

schema.description: due date passed and not CLOSED/CANCELLED
schema.title: Overdue

parameters.description: due date passed and not CLOSED/CANCELLED

get.summary: Get a corrective action with its history

post.summary: Move an action along its lifecycle (CA-2 / CA-3 / CA-4)
post.description: PLANNED > IN_PROGRESS > COMPLETED > VERIFIED > CLOSED. VERIFIED needs verification_result and an independent verified_by_id. CLOSED needs a PASSED verification - closing an unverified action is rejected (422 NOT_VERIFIED). After a FAILED verification the action may be CANCELLED (superseded) and a follow-up planned.

get.description: Plant performance: alarms, acknowledgement delays, floods, nuisance clusters, unsafe conditions, incidents, MTTR and corrective actions. BUSINESS KPIs only - detector precision/recall are under /anomalies/evaluation. Replay duplicates and invalid acknowledgements are excluded and reported separately.

get.description: Sections: overview, alarms, acknowledgements, floods, nuisance, repeated_alarms, unsafe_conditions, incidents, corrective_actions, alarms_per_day

schema.title: Response Kpi Section Api V1 Analytics Kpis  Section  Get
Response Validation Checks Api V1 Validation Checks Get

get.summary: Run all validations on the database
get.description: Totals, passed/failed validations, anomalies detected, error descriptions and affected record ids. Each failed validation lists up to `max_errors` errors unless `full=true`.

schema.title: Response Validation Report Api V1 Validation Report Get

get.summary: Anomalies and patterns found by the detectors
get.description: `kind=anomaly`: the five rule detectors (ack before alarm, impossible interlock state, incident without context, replay duplicate, action closed unverified). `kind=pattern`: flood / nuisance cluster / repeated unsafe condition. Detectors never read ground truth.
Anomaly categories with counts; no ground truth involved.

schema.title: Response Anomaly Summary Api V1 Anomalies Summary Get

get.summary: DETECTION EVALUATION: detectors vs the separate ground truth
get.description: TP / FP / FN, precision, recall, F1 and confusion matrices. This is the only endpoint that reads the ground-truth schema; it is a measure of the detectors, not a business KPI.

schema.title: Response Evaluation Api V1 Anomalies Evaluation Get

ack_outcome.description: ON_TIME, LATE, MISSED (deadline passed, no ack) or PENDING
